title: kms-hsm-drift-detection-and-self-healing-terraform-wrapper
creator: Samira Patel
description: Create a Terraform module (wrapper) that unifies KMS/HSM provider integrations and Secrets Manager/Vault synchronization, with built-in drift detection and a controlled self-healing flow. The module will be used by Private (VPC) deployments to ensure keys and secret backends remain in-sync across environment drifts, automated upgrades, and emergency rotations. Objectives: (1) provide a single terraform interface that can provision customer key material references (Cloud KMS, AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault, and HSM-backed keys via vendor APIs), (2) supply an idempotent secrets sync bridge to Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, (3) implement periodic drift detection checks and lightweight self-healing runbooks that require operator approval for high-risk actions, and (4) expose healthcheck endpoints and metrics consumed by Console and Ops runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Module can provision and reference keys from at least AWS KMS and a simulated HSM provider in CI
Secrets sync job updated via terraform config to push a secret snapshot into Vault and AWS Secrets Manager without manual steps
Automated drift detection runs on a schedule and emits Prometheus metrics when resource drift is detected
Self-healing flow supports two modes: dry-run (report only) and gated-repair (creates a GitHub PR that applies tabled fixes via terraform-runner).
Module creates a healthcheck Lambda (or sidecar) that returns a 200 with structured status: key_status, sync_lag_seconds, last_rotation_ok, and hsm_attestation
End-to-end test run in private staging completes (provision -> rotate -> detect drift -> repair PR created) documented in the Confluence runbook
technical_notes: Design choices: use a thin terraform module that delegates to provider-specific submodules (aws_kms, hsm_provider shim). Drift detection will be handled by a scheduled container running terraform plan + custom comparators for HSM objects (since most HSMs are external APIs). Self-heal will never auto-apply unless the tenant admin sets a toggle; otherwise it will open a GitHub PR populated with the terraform plan diff using terraformer/terraform-plan-to-PR pattern. Secrets synchronization uses Vault's Replication API where available and a fallback push to AWS Secrets Manager via an operator service. Healthchecks export Prometheus metrics via an internal metrics bridge instead of raw CloudWatch for parity across clouds. Keys: do not store raw key material inside state; only references and attestation fingerprints are stored. For HSM attestation, include measurement of signer public key and signed nonce validation.
tasks: Write module scaffold and provider abstraction layer
Implement aws_kms submodule and example reference
Prototype hsm_provider shim with mocked attestation for CI
Build secrets-sync job (container) and terraform resource to deploy it
Create drift-detection runner and metrics exporter
Implement PR-driven gated-repair flow using terraform plan -> GitHub PR
Add healthcheck endpoint and document metrics mapping
Create integration tests in CI (staging) and a canary rotation test
Security review and notes for handling key references and state
Docs: Confluence runbook + quickstart in private-deployments repo
